tools.name: Adobe MCP

clients.label: Another client with MCP server configuration

readiness: Node.js 18 or later is installed (Homebrew installs it for you).
The Adobe app you want to use is installed on this computer.
Your MCP client can launch local stdio servers.
You know which project folders the server should be allowed to access.

claude-code|brew.command:
brew tap zachshallbetter/tap
brew trust zachshallbetter/tap
brew install zachshallbetter/tap/adobe-mcp
claude mcp add --scope user adobe -- adobe-mcp-suite
claude mcp add --scope user indesign -- adobe-mcp-indesign
claude mcp add --scope user illustrator -- adobe-mcp-illustrator
claude mcp add --scope user photoshop -- adobe-mcp-photoshop
claude mcp add --scope user aftereffects -- adobe-mcp-aftereffects
claude mcp add --scope user premiere -- adobe-mcp-premiere
claude-code|brew.explanation: Homebrew installs Node.js 18 or later for you. Registers every Adobe MCP server: one per app, plus the coordinator (adobe) for two Illustrator-to-InDesign workflows. Leave out the lines for apps you don't have, or let creative-mcp setup register only the servers that match your apps.

claude-code|npm.command:
claude mcp add --scope user adobe -- npx -y adobe-mcp-suite
claude mcp add --scope user indesign -- npx -y adobe-mcp-indesign
claude mcp add --scope user illustrator -- npx -y adobe-mcp-illustrator
claude mcp add --scope user photoshop -- npx -y adobe-mcp-photoshop
claude mcp add --scope user aftereffects -- npx -y adobe-mcp-aftereffects
claude mcp add --scope user premiere -- npx -y adobe-mcp-premiere
claude-code|npm.explanation: Registers every Adobe MCP server: one per app, plus the coordinator (adobe) for two Illustrator-to-InDesign workflows. Leave out the lines for apps you don't have, or let creative-mcp setup register only the servers that match your apps.

claude-desktop|brew.explanation: Homebrew installs Node.js 18 or later for you. Add these entries to Claude Desktop's config file (~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json), keeping any servers already there. The path is Homebrew's on Apple silicon; on an Intel Mac it is /usr/local/bin. Registers every Adobe MCP server: one per app, plus the coordinator (adobe) for two Illustrator-to-InDesign workflows. Leave out the lines for apps you don't have, or let creative-mcp setup register only the servers that match your apps.

claude-desktop|npm.explanation: Add these entries to Claude Desktop's config file (~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json), keeping any servers already there. If the client can't start npx, replace it with the full path that "which npx" prints. Registers every Adobe MCP server: one per app, plus the coordinator (adobe) for two Illustrator-to-InDesign workflows. Leave out the lines for apps you don't have, or let creative-mcp setup register only the servers that match your apps.

tools.name: Blender MCP

clients.label: Another client with MCP server configuration

readiness: Homebrew is installed (or Rust and Cargo, to build from source).
Blender is closed while you run blender-mcp addon install, so it can turn the add-on on for you.
Your MCP client can launch local stdio servers.

claude-code|brew.command:
brew tap zachshallbetter/tap
brew trust zachshallbetter/tap
brew install zachshallbetter/tap/blender-mcp
blender-mcp addon install
blender-mcp client add claude-code
claude-code|brew.explanation: Installs the CLI, lets it install and turn on the companion add-on (quit Blender first), then registers the local server with your client. Blender MCP requires Blender 4.0 or later.

claude-code|cargo.command:
cargo install --locked --git https://github.com/zachshallbetter/blender-mcp-rs --package blender-mcp-cli
blender-mcp addon install
blender-mcp client add claude-code
claude-code|cargo.explanation: Installs the CLI, lets it install and turn on the companion add-on (quit Blender first), then registers the local server with your client. Blender MCP requires Blender 4.0 or later.
